description: Build your own car empire in Idle Car Empire – a free idle tycoon for Android. Start with one workshop, run the factories, ship the parts and sell the cars. Get it on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.zazochannel.idlecarempire

descriptions.tiktok: What if you could build your own car empire? 🏭🚗 Start with one small workshop, step inside your factories and grow a whole supply chain in Idle Car Empire. Free on Google Play – link in bio!
